title: Responsive article/knowledge site
learningObjectives: Complete responsive article/knowledge site using the project's existing HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and engineering practices.

understand.concept: A knowledge site organises long-form content through categories, headings, search or navigation, readable line length, and responsive article layouts. Content should remain usable with text enlargement and assistive technology.
understand.whyItMatters: Knowledge sites are judged by how easily people can find and understand information. Strong structure and reading comfort matter more than decorative complexity.
understand.analogy: A knowledge site is a library catalogue and reading room combined.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; project requirements and release quality must be verified against the actual implementation and user needs.

explain.narrative: The article uses a clear title, section heading, and in-page navigation. A complete project should include multiple related articles and category navigation.
